_comment: AnyTeleop (dex-retargeting) finger-retargeting backend. Used only when --mode anyteleop or contact_aware_w_anyteleop is selected. See anyteleop/README.md.
_comment_retargeting_type: 'vector' (real-time video retargeting AnyTeleop uses live) or 'dexpilot' (DexPilot-style pinch-aware optimizer). Both LEAP-supported.
_comment_type_choice: Default 'dexpilot' = the FAITHFUL AnyTeleop config for a dexterous (pinch-capable) hand. Clarification: 'vector-based retargeting' is AnyTeleop's PARADIGM (match finger/keypoint VECTORS, not joint angles); within it dex-retargeting ships TWO optimizers — the plain 'vector' one (base->fingertip only, no thumb coupling) and the 'dexpilot' one (adds the 'Projected' high-weight pinch term that enforces fingertip->thumb contact). For pinching hands AnyTeleop uses the DexPilot optimizer (the library even defaults teleop of dexterous hands to *_dexpilot.yml), which is why the videos pinch well; the bare 'vector' optimizer does NOT reliably close a pinch on LEAP (confirmed here: it under-curls, and raising scaling makes it worse). So benchmark AnyTeleop with 'dexpilot' as its representative condition; 'vector' is available via --anyteleop-type for an ablation, not as 'the AnyTeleop method'. See arXiv:2307.04577 and github.com/dexsuite/dex-retargeting.
_comment_output_alpha: Extra EMA smoothing our wrapper applies on top of dex-retargeting's own low_pass_alpha. 1.0 = none.
_comment_finger_knobs: dex-retargeting's OWN finger-retargeting knobs, overriding the vendored LEAP YAML so you can tune them here instead of editing anyteleop/assets/.../leap_hand_right*.yml. null = keep the YAML value (scaling_factor 1.6, low_pass_alpha 0.2). Hot-reloaded (rebuilds the solver).
_comment_scaling_factor: Robot-to-human hand-size gain (null = YAML-native 1.6). LOWERED to 1.2: at 1.6 the dexpilot type AMPLIFIES hand closure 1.6x, so the commanded fingers close deeper than your actual hand -> they penetrate a grasped object, and the thumb under-abducts when you spread it wide (the pinch-optimizer already resists spreading). 1.2 makes the commanded pose track your real hand more faithfully (less penetration, better thumb spread) at some cost to auto-curl. Hot-reloaded (rebuilds the solver) so tune live; raise back toward 1.4-1.6 if pinch closure weakens too much.
_comment_low_pass_alpha: dex-retargeting's internal low-pass. Smaller = smoother but laggier (0..1); <0 disables.
